description: Several small objects are spread out on a red bedspread, including a beige bowl near the center, a red strawberry-shaped toy, a white block, a yellow puzzle piece, and a couple of small toys on the right. The left hand moves in from the right toward the strawberry toy, pinches and lifts it as the left-hand object, carries it rightward over the bed toward the bowl, and lowers it into the bowl before releasing it so it rests inside.
